capabilities: Aggregate events from Google Calendar, CalDAV, and ICS feed sources into one month view
Color-code and deduplicate events across and within sources
Annotate date cells with Chinese lunar dates, festivals, solar terms, and public holidays
Filter events by title matching rules without deleting underlying data
Auto-sync sources on a configurable interval or via manual command
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Holiday data is fetched from the jsdelivr CDN and cached locally; the plugin otherwise operates locally with credentials stored in the vault's plugin data file. Google setup includes proxy modes for networks that cannot reach Google endpoints.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view that can display events from external calendar services alongside the vault, so users must check separate apps or switch calendars manually.

relations.evidence: aggregates events from Google Calendar, CalDAV servers, and ICS feeds into a single month view
connect to Nextcloud, iCloud, Fastmail, or any CalDAV-compatible server

requires.name: Google account and OAuth client ID/secret

summary: Unified month-view calendar that aggregates events from Google Calendar, CalDAV servers, and ICS feeds, with Chinese lunar and holiday annotations.
